# scope-guard

Purpose: Detect mid-recipe scope creep and push back constructively before the recipe drifts; require explicit user agreement before scope expansion.

Catch mid-flight scope creep ("can you also do X?") and force an explicit recorded decision: (a) decline the expansion, (b) add now with explicit user agreement (updating the stop condition and stage gates), or (c) defer to a follow-up recipe. Prevents silent absorption that breaks gates and stop conditions. Trivial in-gate items may be absorbed only when existing gate criteria explicitly cover them — never by feel.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `process-discipline` | Role `scope-creep-and-change-request-guard` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- mid-recipe, when user adds new requests beyond the brief
- when "while we're at it" appears
- when stages start exceeding their gates "just a bit"
- Trigger phrases: "can you also", "while you're at it", "actually let's also", "one more thing"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- early planning before scope is pinned → use `done-criteria` (`references/skill-done-criteria.md`; use intent-to-3d-brief-writer and done-criteria)
- pure brainstorming with no active recipe → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; use blender-brainstorming)
- when the addition is already explicitly covered by existing gate criteria in stage-gates / acceptance-criteria-builder (verified against w → use `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skill-acceptance-criteria-builder.md`; verified against written criteria, never judged by feel)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `locked_baseline_brief` (`object`): Currently locked 3D brief, acceptance criteria, and stop conditions
- Required input `proposed_scope_change` (`string`): Mid-workflow user request adding new deliverables, environments, animations, or scope
- Optional input `current_workflow_stage` (`string`): Active stage when the scope expansion was requested
- Output contract: `scope_classification_verdict`, `impact_on_locked_brief_and_budget`, `defer_split_or_reopen_decision` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. when scope drift is detected, name it
2. offer 3 options: decline / explicit-add-now (with agreement) / defer to follow-up recipe
3. record the decision before proceeding

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Original brief → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "clear"; brief.locked equals false]`
- [upstream_reference] Stop condition pinned beforehand / updated on expansion → `done-criteria` (`references/skill-done-criteria.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "stop_condition"]`
- [upstream_reference] Per-stage gates enforced / updated on expansion → `stage-gates` (`references/skill-stage-gates.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "stage_gates"]`
- [boundary_delegation] Measurable acceptance rows for added scope → `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skill-acceptance-criteria-builder.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; stage.current equals "acceptance_criteria"]`
- [boundary_delegation] Deferred scope split into follow-up recipes → `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skill-blender-recipe-decomposer.md`) — `when.all: [fit.multiDeliverableDetected equals true]`
- [progression] Delivery gate after scope and gates settle → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_verification"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Process / discipline skill — does not run Blender or execute Python. Decisions govern scope boundaries, stop conditions, and stage gates. A scope decision never upgrades runtime (`Not Run | Attempted | Produced | Verified | Failed`) or artifact (`Not Run | Not Produced | Produced | Verified | Failed`, default `Not Produced`) truth states; truth-state changes are downgrade-only (for example, when added scope invalidates a previously satisfied gate).
- Run Blender.
- Author the recipe.
- Decide for the user (the user picks among options).
